text.tspan: I find myself calling your name,
I let my heart take over my mind,
I get absorbed in those eyes like liquid helium,
I see that face in bliss,
I am lost in the silence of your mind,
I see the beginning and the end,
Now, the hearts calling let's walk together,
share your mind and take my soul,
the end was made for the beginning to come,
In this eternity i see we meet,
